headline: Kifisia Apartment: A Reconfiguration of Domestic Boundaries / Georgios Apostolopoulos Architects
context: The renovation on this 1970s apartment in Kifisia, began with subtraction. All internal partitions were removed to reveal the apartment's spatial potential and expose the existing structure.
